results: Current passing inventory and reconciled operations are required for completion; missing, skipped, stale or failed evidence cannot pass.
Replay does not create an event, increment a revision, repeat an operation or restore a pre-cancellation projection.
Confirmed existing execution can finish after reconciliation without another dispatch; causes and observation references remain recoverable.
limitations: Callers must supply admitted evidence, genuine observations and current context; pure validation cannot authenticate a mutable input/store.
The future store must atomically look up command keys and persist events/projections with history lineage.
Bounded pure projections retain at most 128 operation identities; no accounting reset or larger-history support is implied.
In-flight authority revocation, actual cancellation capabilities, persistence and OS isolation remain later tasks.
